# A Buckeye in Paris

> > A personal blog and podcast by Sarah, an American expat sharing stories, insights, and practical advice about living in Paris and traveling throughout France and beyond.

Sarah (also known as Mme. Arbogast or Mme. Wood) documents her experiences as an American living in France through blog posts and the 'What The French?!' podcast, which features immigrant stories. The site offers travel recommendations, expat life insights, and personal narratives about navigating French culture and international travel.

## Key Topics

- American expat in Paris
- France immigration and expat life
- Paris living
- What The French?! Podcast
- Travel tips and flight booking
- Google Flights and Hopper
- TSA Pre-Check and Global Entry
- Air BnB recommendations
- French culture and lifestyle
- Immigrant stories in France
- Travel accessories and services
- International travel planning
